name: Global Extremum Obfuscation
description: Replaces the local per-edge condition with a global sum over all edges. The target sum is exactly the theoretical maximum of the expression over the valid domain, meaning the global condition can only be satisfied if every individual edge achieves the maximum. This defeats pattern-matching models by presenting as a global optimization or subset-sum problem, forcing the model to explicitly evaluate the expression's bounds to deduce the underlying local bipartite constraint.
